_comment: Claude technical overlay for the canonical agent layer. Descriptions, working-agreement bodies, and closings come from content/agents.json and content/agents/*.md. Everything Claude-specific (model family, tool allowlist, runtime paragraph) lives here. Codex luna roles map to the haiku family and Codex sol roles map to opus; read-only OpenCode permission maps collapse to the read tool set while workspace-write maps add Edit and Write.
runtime_paragraph: You run as a Claude Code subagent with a fresh context for exactly one assignment. Sibling agent outputs are invisible to you. Your prompt carries the only handoff you may trust. Never ask the user a question.
